We need to train XGBoost model but directory for model didn't exist. We can create directory then re-run training. Need to ensure path exists. Use write_file to create directory? Actually need to create directory. There's no tool to make directory directly, but writing a file will create intermediate directories? It may fail if directory missing. We can create a dummy file then maybe training will succeed writing model file. Better to create the directory path first by writing a placeholder file then delete? Or we can change model_save_path to a path that exists, like using existing directory e.g., dataset folder. Let's create a new path: "/Users/.../ml_nitrides_trial_25/model/xgb_nitrides.pkl". Need to ensure model directory exists. We can create a placeholder file there? Actually training will attempt to write model file; if directory exists, it will succeed. So we need to create the directory. We can write a dummy file inside that directory to create it, then training will overwrite? It will try to open file for writing, which will overwrite placeholder. That's fine.

We already created placeholder.txt inside model folder, which also creates the folder. So now folder exists. Need to re-run train_xgboost_model with same path but now file exists; it will overwrite. Let's run again.
